attr.title: Super Off Road
attr.desc: Ivan 'Ironman' Stewart's Super Off Road, the 1990 DOS version by Graftgold of Leland's arcade racer, rebuilt from the DOS program's own logic. Four trucks race eight dirt tracks, forwards and reversed, buying nitro, tires, shocks, acceleration and top speed in the Speed Shop between races. Up to three players.
attr.inst: Copy the original DOS game's files into ports/superoffroad/gamedata/. SORP checks every file and names any that are missing or not the DOS release's own in ports/superoffroad/log.txt.
